dispatch_summary: Plan complete for task 952. 8 phases, 11 estimated hours, 7 dependency waves. All edits target agent-system/extensions/** (source store); zero .claude/** hand-authoring. The plan encodes the prerequisite's four established answers rather than re-deriving them, and uses the research report's re-verified grep anchors (the task description's line numbers were confirmed stale). Five binding design decisions resolve the research report's open questions: (D1) the recursion guard must match a recursion_guard:true SUBSET of orchestrator-critical-paths.json, since the full list contains skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md and skill-base.sh whose defects must stay recordable -- a defect the research did not surface; (D2) the completion-claim gate attributes via a fixed log_prefix two-entry lookup, firing only on the Case 3/3 refuse branch and never on Case 1; (D3) five new Signal A instances are added as an explicit documented decision rather than stretching existing instances and corrupting the dedup identity key; (D4) a per-hook attribution-outcome table records that three of five hooks are expected to log-only under Signal B, which is the predicate working as designed; (D5) the recorder synthesizes a session id when hooks supply only Claude Code's native UUID. Also encoded: deploy-root-guard.sh makes the recorder unrunnable from the source store, so Phase 3 exists as an explicit deploy-then-verify gate. Phase 8 satisfies the task's verification requirement with a matched positive (bare-string artifacts array fires ARTIFACTS_SHAPE_MISMATCH, exactly one attributed row) and two negatives (schema-conformant failed and partial produce zero rows). No AskUserQuestion anywhere; no task creation; no surfacing to the user -- all downstream scope.
